column1: # 超级马力欧兄弟 惊奇（Switch，基础版 v0 与更新 1.2.1）的游戏档案。本目录另有着色器表（shader_split.py 生成）、c1_full.tsv、pso_manifest.tsv 与翻译链版本头 dmsh_chain.h

# Game profile of Super Mario Bros. Wonder (Switch, base game v0 and update 1.2.1). This folder also holds the shader tables (generated by shader_split.py), c1_full.tsv, pso_manifest.tsv and the chain version header dmsh_chain.h
# 格式：键 <TAB> 值；一个键多个值用空格分隔；build 每版一行；注释只能独占一行。改内存 / NVN 常数后重编宿主；改着色器相关的键后按 AGENTS.md 走翻译链流程

# Format: key <TAB> value; several values of one key are separated by spaces; one build row per version; comments must be on their own line. Rebuild the host after changing memory / NVN constants; after changing shader-related keys follow the chain procedure in AGENTS.md
# 游戏名不写在这里：NSP 脚本从 NSP 的控制数据（NACP）取 | the game name is not kept here: the NSP script takes it from the NSP's control data (NACP)
# svcGetInfo(ProgramId) 报给游戏的值（运行时 DM_PROGRAM_ID 可改） | the value svcGetInfo(ProgramId) reports to the game (DM_PROGRAM_ID overrides it at run time)
# 游戏名：只给档案列表与 Mac 窗口标题当标签；iOS App 名取基础版 NSP 里的游戏名，包名按基础版标题号（build_ipa.sh / NSP 脚本）

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# build <版本> <显示版本> <模块>=<构建号>…：NSP 脚本只认这些构建（写死的地址在别的构建上不成立）；宿主按 main 的构建号报显示版本

# build <version> <display version> <module>=<build ID>...: the NSP script accepts only these builds (fixed addresses do not hold on other builds); the host reports the display version by main's build ID
# 缺省打进 IPA 的版本 | version packed into the IPA by default
# 着色器表是这几个版本的并集（基础版在前）：出包时这些版本都要有 | the shader tables are the union of these versions (base game first): all of them are needed to build
# 改写并装载的代码模块（装载顺序；rtld 由宿主代替） | code modules rewritten and loaded (load order; rtld is replaced by the host)
# RomFS 里必须有的路径（认游戏文件放对了没有） | a path that must exist in the RomFS (tells whether the game files are in the right place)
# zip 时不再压缩的扩展名（本身已压缩） | extensions zip stores without compressing (already compressed)
# ---- 内存（hle_svc.c；分区依据见那里的注释） | Memory (hle_svc.c; the reasons for the partition are in its comments) ----
# ---- NVN 驱动常量段（dmsh_build.py 出包、nvn_mtl.m 运行时现填；按全库着色器实测） | NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time; measured over all shaders) ----
# c2：贴图句柄表 0x20 + 8 r（32 槽）、分离采样器表 0x568、图像句柄表 0x120 + 8 r（8 槽）；translator 内置同值，不同就要先让翻译器可配

# c2: texture handle table 0x20 + 8 r (32 slots), separate sampler table 0x568, image handle table 0x120 + 8 r (8 slots); the translator has the same values built in, so a game that differs needs a configurable translator first
# c0：存储缓冲表基址（每阶段 16 槽 × 0x10） | c0: storage buffer table bases (16 slots × 0x10 per stage)

# 来源组：路径里含前者就归后者组（按顺序取第一个；main 内嵌的固定归 main，都不中归 other） | source groups: a path containing the first part goes to the second group (first match wins; shaders embedded in main always go to main, no match goes to other)
# 映射表表头里的着色器来源说明 | description of the shader source in the map table header
